environment.description: Application deployed in an EKS pod with a distroless base image containing only the Python runtime and pdflatex/pandoc binaries. The pod spec includes a Seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) AND a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-report-restrict' loaded on all nodes. The AppArmor profile denies capability 'cap_sys_admin', denies write to /** except /var/lib/reports/**, denies execute of /bin/sh and /bin/bash and /usr/bin/bash (the profile uses 'deny /bin/sh rx,' and 'deny /bin/bash rx,' and 'deny /usr/bin/bash rx,'). Additionally, the pod runs with securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (port 53/UDP) and the internal database endpoint (port 5432). No internet egress is permitted from the pod.

config.base_image: gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12 (custom with pdflatex,pandoc added, no shell binaries)
config.apparmor_profile: k8s-report-restrict: deny /bin/sh rx, deny /bin/bash rx, deny /usr/bin/bash rx, deny /usr/bin/dash rx, deny capability sys_admin, deny /** w except /var/lib/reports/**
